workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: GUID of the workflow containing the node.

node_guid.title: Node Guid
node_guid.description: GUID of the Data Map node.

id.title: Id
id.description: The code table's id, for a change to an existing table.

from.title: SideModel
from.description:
A From or To system of a table: its name and, where known, the FHIR
system URL, the OID, the HL7 v2 name and the schema code set id.

to.title: SideModel
to.description:
A From or To system of a table: its name and, where known, the FHIR
system URL, the OID, the HL7 v2 name and the schema code set id.

anyOf.title: CreateModel
anyOf.description: A new table's name and its From / To systems (Requirement 4.11).

create.description: A new table's name and systems; set instead of id.

items.title: RowModel
items.description:
One entry of a code table; only ``from_code`` is required
(Requirement 3.1).

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: The rows to merge or replace, as JSON.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Which column holds each field (from_code, from_name, to_code, to_name); the grid guesses when omitted.

has_header.title: Has Header
has_header.description: Whether the first row is a header.

anyOf.title: CsvInputModel
anyOf.description:
A CSV file sent to the API: its bytes as base64, an optional column
choice ({from_code, from_name, to_code, to_name} -> index) and whether the
first row is a header (Requirement 3.2).

csv.description: The rows as a CSV file; set instead of rows.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: merge (add and update by From code) or replace (the table's rows become exactly these).

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: A new name for the table.

anyOf.title: SideModel
anyOf.description:
A From or To system of a table: its name and, where known, the FHIR
system URL, the OID, the HL7 v2 name and the schema code set id.

sides.title: Sides
sides.description: New From / To systems, as [from, to]; nulls leave a side unchanged.

base_text.title: Base Text
base_text.description: Preview against this text instead of the file on disk (the Map view's unsaved text).

include_text.title: Include Text
include_text.description: Include the file text a save would write.

schema.title: PreviewRequest
schema.description:
A preview body: a change, plus ``base_text`` (the Map view previews
against the text it holds, Requirement 4.12) and ``include_text`` (return
the file a save would write, Requirement 4.7).
